notes.title: Characters Update
notes.content:
## 🎉 Build 18600514 is LIVE - New Classes Arrive! 🎉

Survivors, prepare for a fresh challenge! This update introduces [b]new playable Classes[/b], each bringing unique active and passive abilities to the fight. Discover new strategies and master new playstyles!

[h2]Meet the Specialists:[/h2]

[h3]Commando[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Active:[/b] Hurl an explosive knife; kills reduce its cooldown.
[*] [b]Passive:[/b] Kills grant a temporary reload speed boost.
[/list]

[h3]Medic[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Active:[/b] Deploy healing gas that also makes zombies bleed.
[*] [b]Passive:[/b] Shooting bleeding zombies triggers their full bleed damage instantly.
[/list]

[h3]Sniper[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Active:[/b] Slow time for zombies; headshot kills during this refund bullets.
[*] [b]Passive:[/b] Single-shot kills on full-HP enemies cause bullets to ricochet.
[/list]

[h3]Rich Man[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Active: [/b]Toss a coin; shoot it mid-air to unleash a spray of golden bullets.
[*] [b]Passive:[/b] Consecutive kill shots grant stacking bonus gold.
[/list]

[h3]Special Forces[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Active:[/b] Use a smoke cloak to temporarily confuse zombie tracking.
[*] [b]Passive:[/b] Faster empty-mag weapon swaps with a temporary damage boost.
[/list]

(Rookie remains the starter class with no special abilities.)

Each class has its own unlock challenge. Dive in, experiment, and dominate the horde!

See you in the fight,
Eren

notes.title: Update Notes - 8 April 2025
notes.content:
- Pressing ESC while at shop will now close shop
- Pressing Reload when magazine is full won't trigger reload to prevent wasting magazine
- Reworked character animation system to be multiplayer compatible
- Disabled Nanite and removed option for it, most assets will now render at LoD 0 which still ends up being faster than having Nanite enabled
- Improved visualization of weapon buttons at shop
- Added send feedback button to main menu
- Significantly optimized zombie processing, should result in ~%60 increased FPS at later waves
- Added support for DLSS 4 Transformer & improved quality of temporal anti-aliasing
- Various backend improvements in preparation of multiplayer

notes.title: Update notes for 22 February
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Decrease explosion sound of barrel
[*] Optimize minimap rendering performance
[*] Increase RPG price
[*] Added floating damage numbers & healthbar above zombies (optional, controlled under graphics settings)
[*] Added gamma calibration under display settings
[*] Removed runtime virtual textures, was causing blurry textures.
[*] Pressing ESC in game now pauses the game
[*] Fixed a bug with shop items not being purchasable if under discount buff
[*] Fixed simulation speed being dependent in game FPS if under 60
[*] Fixed settings menu opening twice and never closing
[/list]
